svg.title: Warehouse picker — Queer person
svg.desc: A fictional queer person whose gender is unspecified working as warehouse picker, wearing a safety vest and a peaked work cap. Visible work cue: Two boxed shelf levels stand beside a separate handled picking tote rather than a generic warehouse building. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Occupational headgear: a peaked work cap.
